name: Royal Copenhagen Porcelain
about: This is Danish design porcelain from Copenhagen's famous porcelain maker. It is a classic gift from the city.
tip: Check the country of production and the quality grade to confirm it is genuine.

name: Lakrids by Bülow Liquorice Chocolate
about: These are Nordic liquorice-flavored sweets. The salty-sweet taste is an acquired one, so people either love or dislike it.
tip: If you are unsure, choose the chocolate-coated version, which is milder.
